summary.title: ConnectED
summary.description:
ConnectED is an offline-first examination management PWA for Kenyan schools. This model covers the teacher app and its sync layer, the Laravel API, the admin panel, the queue worker, the model provider, and production on AWS as declared in infra/.

Data subjects are students (mostly minors), teachers, and admins. Parents and students are not users: they receive a printed or forwarded report card and are outside the diagram.

The institution boundary is logical, not drawn: every institution shares one database and one API, separated by institution_id under an Eloquent global scope.

Sources: docs/spec/, docs/adr/ 0001, 0002, 0006, 0007, 0009 to 0015, api/routes/api.php, and frontend/src/lib/localDatabase.ts.

diagrams.title: ConnectED level 1 data flow (STRIDE)
diagrams.description: First draft of the data flow diagram, for review. No threats recorded yet. The LINDDUN diagram will be a copy of this one once the elements are agreed.

data.name: Teacher device (browser, often offline)
data.description: A teacher's own phone or laptop. Not managed by the school, may be shared or lost, and holds a copy of the institution's data. Everything inside is under the device holder's control, so the server treats every value that leaves it as a claim (docs/spec/sync-protocol.md, Authorization and scoping).

data.name: AWS account, af-south-1 (ADR 0015)
data.description: Production as declared in infra/. Reached from the internet only through CloudFront. Currently taken down to save cost; the model describes it as deployed.

label.text: Application host (EC2: nginx, PHP-FPM, queue worker)

data.name: Application host (EC2: nginx, PHP-FPM, queue worker)
data.description: One t4g.small host in the default network. Its security group accepts HTTP only from CloudFront's published address range, and nginx refuses requests without the origin secret header.

data.name:
Teacher
(incl. HOD, DOS)
data.description: A teacher account (ADR 0014). Reads everything in the institution and may grade anything. HOD (subject moderation link) and Director of Studies are layered grants on the same account: conflict moderation, unlock, and term close. Signs in to the app only.

data.name:
School admin
(back office)
data.description: An admin account: secretary, registrar, or bursar. Signs in to the Filament panel only, with an authenticator app in production. Writes the roster, accounts, role grants, and the term calendar. Does no academic work and never holds a device token.

data.name:
Model provider
(Anthropic API)
data.description: Third party outside the school and outside Kenya. Receives comment prompts (levels and trends, no names) through the batch API and assistant questions with tool results (figures including percentages, students as handles) through the live API (ADRs 0012 and 0013).

data.name:
GitHub Actions
(deploy and infra)
data.description: Workflows of this repository, signed in to AWS through OIDC. The apply role is an administrator; what guards it is that only a run on main can assume it (ADR 0015).

data.name:
PWA
(React app and
service worker)
data.description: The screens, the router, and the Workbox service worker. Reads the local store; every write goes to the outbox first. Makes the online-only calls itself: login, unlock, term close, Reports, the assistant, and report card download.

data.name: Sync runner
data.description: Our own code (ADR 0006): drains the outbox to POST /sync, pulls the change log from GET /sync by cursor, applies verdicts, and reconciles conflicts into the local store.

data.name:
Session
(Dexie: sessions)
data.description: The Sanctum bearer token and the signed-in user, in IndexedDB. Tokens carry the sync ability and have no expiry (config/sanctum.php); they end at logout, deactivation, or revocation by an admin.

data.name:
App shell cache
(Workbox precache)
data.description: Precached JavaScript, CSS, and self-hosted fonts, so the app starts with no connection. Whatever is cached here is the code that handles the token and the marks.

data.name:
Local records
(Dexie tables)
data.description: The device's copy of the institution: students (name, gender, date of birth), enrolments, users (name, email), marks, results, conflicts, comments, report rows, and notifications. Any teacher reads everything in the institution, so the copy is institution-wide. Not encrypted beyond what the device itself provides.

data.name:
Outbox
(Dexie: outbox)
data.description: Unsettled local writes (ADR 0011): one entry per mutation with a client mutation id, base version, and changed fields only.

data.name: CloudFront
data.description: The one public HTTPS address. Serves the PWA from S3, and forwards /api, /admin, and the panel's assets to the host uncached, adding the origin secret header.

data.name:
PWA assets
(S3 bucket)
data.description: The built frontend. Written only by the deploy workflow.

data.name: nginx
data.description: Refuses any request without CloudFront's secret header, then hands off to PHP-FPM.

data.name:
Auth API
(/login, /logout,
/me)
data.description: POST /login is the one route that reads across institutions, since no account is resolved yet; throttled. Issues one Sanctum token per device with the sync ability. Refuses admin accounts.

data.name:
Sync API
(GET and POST
/sync)
data.description: The server half of the contribution. Push: idempotency by mutation id, version check, field-level merge, conflict raising, and accept or reject verdicts. Pull: sync_changes by cursor. Institution and actor come from the token, never the payload; server-owned fields in a payload are invalid.

text.text:
Online API
(reads, unlock,
term close, reports)

data.name:
Online API
(reads, unlock,
term close, reports)
data.description: Read endpoints for classes, subjects, students, and assessments; unlock (HOD or DOS); term close (DOS); the analytics summary; and the presigned report card URL. All behind auth:sanctum, EnsureAccountIsActive, and the institution global scope.

data.name:
Report assistant
(/reports/assistant)
data.description: Runs the tool loop server-side (ADR 0013): scope gate, read-only analytics tools, structured output, grounding check, handle-to-name restoration, per-user rate limit. Templated stand-in when no model key is set.

data.name:
Admin panel
(Filament, /admin)
data.description: Server-rendered back office with its own session guard (ADRs 0009 and 0014). The only writer of students, enrolments, classes, subjects, criteria, accounts, role grants, token revocation, and terms.

data.name: Queue worker
data.description: Laravel queue on the database driver (ADR 0007). Submits and collects comment batches, renders report card PDFs with Dompdf, and writes them to S3.

data.name:
App settings
(.env from
Parameter Store)
data.description: Written on each deploy from /connected/production/ in Parameter Store: the Laravel key, the model API key, the bucket name. The database password is managed by RDS in Secrets Manager. Read by every PHP process on the host; the two flows drawn are the ones that carry a third party's key.

data.name:
Application release
(code on the host)
data.description: The Laravel application as deployed: the code every API request, panel page, and job runs. Replaced by each merge to main.

data.name:
Accounts and tokens
(Postgres)
data.description: users (name, email, password hash, kind, directs_studies, deactivated_at), personal_access_tokens (hashed), panel sessions, and admins' authenticator secrets and recovery codes.

data.name:
Domain tables
(Postgres)
data.description: Every institution's rows in one database, separated by institution_id under an Eloquent global scope: students, enrolments, classes, subjects, criteria, assessments, marks, conflicts, results, comments, reports, terms, term_closures, notifications, and unlock_notes. Soft deletes throughout. RDS, single zone, seven days of backups.

data.name:
Sync logs
(sync_changes,
sync_mutations)
data.description: Append-only. sync_changes is the pull cursor and holds every changed field of every record; sync_mutations records every decided push with user, payload hash, verdict, the device's claimed time, and the server's received time.

data.name:
Jobs and cache
(Postgres)
data.description: jobs and failed_jobs (payloads name records by id), comment_generations, and the cache table, which holds assistant conversations in handle form with the handle-to-student mapping until they expire.

data.name:
Report card PDFs
(S3 bucket)
data.description: One PDF per student per term, keyed reports/{institution}/{report}.pdf. Each carries the student's name, school, performance levels, and the teacher's remark. Read only through a ten minute presigned URL.

data.name:
Credentials, marks,
commands, questions
data.description: Typed or tapped by whoever holds the device. A password at sign-in; after that the device's stored token speaks for the teacher.

data.name: Bearer token
data.description: Written at sign-in, cleared at logout.

data.name: Bearer token
data.description: Read for every sync request.

data.name: App code and fonts
data.description: Served by the service worker with no network.

data.name:
Read and write
records
data.description: Screens read here; a local write lands here and in the outbox in one Dexie transaction.

data.name:
Queued mutations
(changed fields only)
data.description: Every write goes here first.

data.name: Pending mutations
data.description: Drained in order when a connection is available.

data.name: Verdicts
data.description: Accepted, merged, conflict, invalid, or forbidden per entry.

data.name:
Pulled changes and
conflict records
data.description: The server's change log applied to the local copy.

data.name:
POST /sync:
mutations
data.description: Mutation id, table, record id, base version, changed fields, and the device's claimed time. Bearer token.

data.name:
GET /sync:
change log
data.description: Every change in the institution since the device's cursor, including students' personal data and other teachers' marks.

labelText.text:
Online calls:
login, reads, unlock, term close,
reports, assistant

data.name:
Online calls:
login, reads, unlock, term close,
reports, assistant
data.description: Password at login; bearer token after. Responses carry the token, the user's roles, analytics figures, assistant answers with names restored, and presigned URLs.

data.name:
App shell
and updates
data.description: Fetched and precached by the service worker.

data.name: Static files
data.description: Origin fetch from the bucket.

data.name:
Report card PDF
(presigned URL)
data.description: Fetched directly from S3, not through CloudFront or the API. The URL is the only credential and is valid for ten minutes.

labelText.text:
Panel pages and forms
(password, TOTP, session cookie)

data.name:
Panel pages and forms
(password, TOTP, session cookie)
data.description: Roster, accounts, role grants, token revocation, and the term calendar.

data.name:
/api and /admin
(plain HTTP,
origin secret header)
data.description: Not encrypted: a certificate needs a domain (ADR 0015, decision 7). Carries passwords, bearer tokens, session cookies, and every sync payload between CloudFront and the host's public address.

data.name: Users and tokens
data.description: Looks up the account by email across institutions, checks the password hash, and writes or deletes the token row.

data.name: Token lookup
data.description: Resolves the token to a user and an institution; EnsureAccountIsActive rechecks the account on every request. The other API processes do the same.

data.name:
Versioned writes,
conflicts, notifications
data.description: Marks, assessments, conflict and comment commands, and the unread flag, inside SyncLog::transaction under the institution's lock.

data.name:
Append changes
and verdicts
data.description: Written in the same transaction as the record, so seq order equals commit order (ADR 0010).

data.name:
Changes since cursor;
prior verdicts
data.description: The pull response, and the idempotency and history reads of a push.

labelText.text:
Reads; unlock and
term close writes

data.name:
Reads; unlock and
term close writes
data.description: Unlock writes unlock_notes and soft deletes results, and may unwind a term close. Term close creates pending comments. These writes also append to the sync logs through Syncable.

data.name:
Dispatch generation
and report jobs
data.description: After commit (ADR 0007).

data.name:
Analytics queries
(read only)
data.description: Through AnalyticsQueryService and the fixed tool set; no SQL from the model.

data.name:
Conversation history
and handle mapping
data.description: Cache table, short expiry.

data.name:
Questions and tool results
(handles, percentages)
data.description: Live API. No student name, admission number, or school name; a name typed in lower case or not on the roster is not caught (ADR 0013, decision 4, provisional).

data.name:
Roster, setup,
and term calendar
data.description: Writes go through Syncable, so they reach devices by pull.

data.name:
Comments, reports,
results, notifications
data.description: Reads marks and results; applies generated remarks and records report rows.

data.name:
Comment batches
(levels and trends only)
data.description: Batch API. Refers to 'the student'; never a name, percentage, or position (ADR 0012, decision 5).

data.name: Rendered PDFs
data.description: Written before the final check; a stale job deletes its object.

data.name:
Release
(SSM Run Command)
data.description: A new release directory on the host: install, migrations, caching, then go live only if all three succeed.

data.name:
Built PWA
(aws s3 sync)
data.description: Whatever lands here becomes the code every device runs.
